scope: Regex-source records, not fully instantiated TableGen opcodes, aliases, expanded multiclasses, or a silicon complete ISA. Inventories every class/multiclass/def/defm/defvar/defset token outside comments and strings in all immediate aie2p/*.td except four scheduling/itinerary files. Includes nested and anonymous declarations; does not evaluate foreach, let, inheritance, includes, predicates, aliases, or compiler patterns. Shared AIE base declarations and clang C/API headers are not recursively cataloged. AIE2P arch 21 only, not AIE2PS arch 22. Counts are source declarations, never instruction counts or hardware throughput.
